import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    # if data starts and ends with double quotes, strip them
    if len(data) >= 2 and data[0] == '"' and data[-1] == '"':
        s = data[1:-1]
    else:
        s = data
    # reverse in-place using list
    lst = list(s)
    i, j = 0, len(lst) - 1
    while i < j:
        lst[i], lst[j] = lst[j], lst[i]
        i += 1
        j -= 1
    reversed_s = ''.join(lst)
    print(f'Reversed string: "{reversed_s}"')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
